description:
[ESP HW | STM HW] Flash firmware. Danger tier: it always runs a preflight first, always returns that preflight (refusal included), and needs a confirmation before writing anything.
Preflight reports: the device's USB mode, which role the target port plays (the STM32 bridge console is refused as a flash target), the binary's own version string, whether it is older than the newest file under main/ or components/, and whether the build's board revision matches the device's — a mismatch is a blocker, because the revisions differ in pinout and the wrong image looks like dead hardware.
target='esp': transport='ota' streams over USB CDC with the device running (no bootloader mode); transport='uart' runs idf.py flash and needs download mode. wait_boot=true then opens the console and returns a BootResult.
target='stm': method='swd' (ST-Link) or 'dfu' (system bootloader, hold pad 1 at boot).
The flash runs as a job: wait_seconds=0 (default) returns a task handle for crosspad_task; wait_seconds>0 inlines the final status. dry_run=true stops after the preflight. force=true overrides every blocker except the port-role refusal.

boot_timeout_s.description: wait_boot: how long to wait for a complete boot (default 45, the firmware's own boot budget).

build_dir.description: ESP only. Build directory holding the binary and its sdkconfig (default: '<idf-root>/build_<rev>' of the board being flashed, from tools/crosspad_board.py; per-revision dirs are build_v1 / build_v2).

build_type.description: STM only. Picks the build/<preset> dir for the default binary. Default Debug.

confirm_token.description: Token from a previous confirmation_required result. Re-issue the identical call with it to proceed.

delta_base.description: ESP OTA only. Previously flashed binary to diff against — sends a delta instead of the whole image.

device.description: ESP only. Device id (dev_xxxx) or one of its port paths; omit when exactly one CrossPad is connected.

dry_run.description: Run the preflight and stop: no confirmation token is minted and nothing is written.

firmware_path.description: Custom binary. ESP default '<build_dir>/CrossPad.bin'; STM default '<stm-root>/build/<preset>/CrossPad_STM32_r20.bin'.

force.description: Proceed despite preflight blockers (stale build, board-revision mismatch, missing device). The port-role and no-board refusals are never overridden.

method.description: STM only. 'swd' = ST-Link; 'dfu' = the STM32 system bootloader (hold pad 1 at boot).

port.description: ESP only. Serial port to flash. Omit to let the daemon choose. The STM32 bridge console port is refused — it carries logs, not the flash.

target.description: 'esp' = ESP32-S3 application firmware (transport uart|ota); 'stm' = STM32G0 bridge firmware via STM32_Programmer_CLI (method swd|dfu).

transport.description: ESP only. 'ota' streams the binary over USB CDC with the device running (no bootloader mode); 'uart' runs idf.py flash and needs download mode.

wait_boot.description: ESP only. After flashing, open the console and wait for the boot markers; the job result carries a BootResult {complete, missing, fatal, errors, bootloops, seconds}. Default false.

wait_seconds.description: 0 (default) returns the task handle immediately — poll it with crosspad_task. >0 waits that long and inlines the task status; a timeout is not an error, the job keeps running.

name: crosspad_flash
